customManagers.description: The Postgres image scripts/db.sh runs locally, pinned by digest like the CI service image

packageRules.description: A new distroless digest is how a fixed CVE in Node or Debian reaches the image, so it releases

Browser tests run in Playwright's image, whose browsers must match the playwright package. Renovate doesn't update the image's tag or digest, so it can't ship ahead of the package. The next rule moves it
Move Playwright's image in the workflows to the playwright package's version and pin its digest, in the same commit as the package

One Postgres image in scripts/db.sh and the CI service, so local and CI tests run the same server. The digest in the title keeps each PR's title unique, because Renovate disables automerge when a PR with the same title already merged
The post-upgrade task renames gcr.io/distroless/nodejs<major> in the Dockerfile to the new Node.js major and pins its digest
Never automerge these, even minor and patch updates: the ORM and driver change the SQL airway runs, the MCP SDK changes what agents see, and ECharts changes every chart
